documents.name: Eyal Shani Background
documents.source: Eyal Shani is one of Israel's most celebrated and unconventional chefs, known for his philosophical approach to cooking and his empire of restaurants. He is the founder of North Abraxas, HaSalon, and the global Miznon chain. His cooking philosophy centers on elevating simple, fresh ingredients to their purest form. He is famous for his roasted cauliflower, which became an iconic Israeli dish worldwide. Eyal's restaurants are known for their raw, energetic atmosphere and open kitchens. He has restaurants in Tel Aviv, New York, Paris, Vienna, and Melbourne. He often writes poetically about food, comparing a tomato to a piece of art. Eyal is known for his wild curly hair and larger-than-life personality. He is a regular presence at international food festivals. His Miznon chain brought Israeli street food — especially the pita wrap — to the world stage. He believes in sourcing locally and celebrating Israeli and Middle Eastern produce. Eyal mentors young chefs and is considered a godfather of modern Israeli cuisine. He was featured in major international culinary publications including Bon Appétit and the World's 50 Best Restaurants list.
